offers.description: Fixed price per vehicle for up to 4 passengers departing 07:00–22:00.

mainEntity.name: How long does the drive really take in winter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Around 1 h 50 on clear roads. On a peak Saturday in January, with changeover traffic through Wörgl and fresh snow on the final climb, 2 h 15 is more realistic. We plan for the worse case rather than the brochure figure.

mainEntity.name: Do you drop at the chalet or the town centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: At the door. Kitzbühel has a lot of narrow one-way streets in the old town — tell us the address when you book and we will work out the access rather than leaving you to drag cases across cobbles.
Yes. The motorway vignette and every toll on the route are in the €300. The price you see is the price you pay.

mainEntity.name: Can you take us to the Hahnenkamm races?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and we would book early. The race weekend in late January is the single busiest date of the Tyrolean year and our one-booking-per-day rule means the date goes to whoever confirms first.

mainEntity.name: What about ski and board bags?

acceptedAnswer.text: One bag per two people fits comfortably in a V-Class. Larger groups or unusual luggage — tell us and we will assign a car with a roof box.
